violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Meals (26 TAC §746.501(a)(10))
violation_type.typical_finding: Option that the school can provide meals for the children or that parents can provide meals for their child needs to be added to the operational policies.

finding_variants.text: Option that the school can provide meals for the children or that parents can provide meals for their child needs to be added to the operational policies.

The operation does not have the following policies:   Months of operation  Meal practices  Parent rights  Procedures for reviewing the licensing report and minimum standards  Emergency prepardness plan  Preventing and Responding to Abuse/Neglect  Gang-free zone information  Accomodations for children with special needs  Parent participation  Promotion of outdoor/indoor play  Procedures for suspension/expulsion
The operational policies did not include information for meal services/practices.

Operational Policies included that snacks would be provided by the school. When asked about meals, Director stated that parents had the option to bring in their child's meals or order through a service, Crave It.    Note: corrected at inspection.
Meals were not included in the operational policies.
The operation stated a policy was in place regarding children's meals; however, it was not found in the operation's policies.
